items.headline: Minnesota fires OC Greg Harbaugh Jr., ending third stint with Gophers
items.description: Minnesota fired offensive coordinator Greg Harbaugh Jr. as the Golden Gophers rank 15th in the Big Ten in scoring and 17th in yards per game.

items.headline: Becht, Hansen combine to push Penn State past Minnesota 42-14
items.description: — Rocco Becht threw three touchdown passes and ran for another score and Penn State pulled away from Minnesota 42-14 on Saturday.

items.headline: FAA ground stop throws sports world into travel chaos ahead of weekend games
items.description: Travel plans for teams in multiple sports were disrupted by the FAA's nationwide ground stop of all flights because of communications problems.

items.headline: Can Minnesota complete full rivalry trophy gauntlet vs. Penn State?
items.description: Minnesota holds three of its four official rivalry trophies for the first time since 1978, and they may control all four for the first time ever by Saturday night.

items.headline: 2027 NFL draft Big Board rankings: Mel Kiper's top 25 prospects, best by position
items.description: Seven quarterbacks ranked in the top 25? This NFL draft class could be fun. Mel Kiper Jr. stacks the best players on the board as of mid-November.

items.headline: College Football Playoff Bubble Watch after second ranking
items.description: A conference-by-conference look at which teams are contending for the playoff, who's close, and who's out.
